visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair in a high bun, wearing a distressed denim vest over a white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. She points with black-gloved hands toward the center of the frame where large black-and-white text overlays appear. Behind her is a white rice cooker with floral patterns and a stainless steel sink. (2) She presents various food items: two green cucumbers on a wooden cutting board with a yellow-handled knife, a blue container of yogurt, a silver tuna can, and a can of corn. She smiles widely, holding two cucumbers near her face. (3) Three white peeled hard-boiled eggs appear in a clear plastic container on the counter. The woman holds the knife and points to the cucumbers, then begins slicing one cucumber into thin rounds on the wooden board. (4) In a clear plastic bin, she uses a metal fork to mash the three hard-boiled eggs into small chunks. She then pours yellow corn kernels from a can into the bin with the mashed eggs and cucumber slices. (5) She adds pink-toned tuna chunks from a silver can and then scoops thick white yogurt from the blue container into the mix. She licks the yogurt container lid, then adds black pepper from a tall grinder. (6) She snaps the lid onto the clear bin and shakes it vigorously with both hands. She opens it to reveal the mixed salad and tastes a spoonful, looking surprised and pleased. (7) She holds up a plastic toy chicken and then a large pile of shredded chicken meat as visual aids for alternative ingredients. She continues eating the salad with a spoon, smiling at the camera and gesturing with her hands.
